ic_name: MIPI SPMI v2.0 + RFFE v3.0 (System Power Management + RF Front-End Control)

fsm_states.name: IDLE
fsm_states.description: Bus idle (SCLK low, SDATA low); devices listen for an SSC.

fsm_states.name: ARBITRATION
fsm_states.description: (SPMI) Masters contend for the bus on command priority / MASTER_ID; slaves may raise a Request. Resolved before the winner's SSC. (RFFE has a single master, no arbitration.)

fsm_states.name: SSC
fsm_states.description: The winning/sole master drives the Sequence Start Condition (SDATA pulse while SCLK low).

fsm_states.name: COMMAND
fsm_states.description: Command Frame: slave identifier (SLAVE_ID / USID-GSID) + opcode, MSB-first + odd parity.

fsm_states.name: ADDRESS
fsm_states.description: Address Frame (for register-addressed commands): 8-bit or 16-bit register address + parity.

fsm_states.name: DATA
fsm_states.description: Data Frame(s): 8 data bits MSB-first + parity each; Extended/Long carry a byte count.

fsm_states.name: BUS_PARK
fsm_states.description: Bus Park Cycle terminates the transaction and returns the bus to IDLE.

fsm_states.name: PARITY_ERROR
fsm_states.description: A frame parity check fails; the receiver ignores the frame.

fsm_states.name: TRIGGER
fsm_states.description: (RFFE) A Trigger event applies previously written trigger-register values simultaneously.

fsm_states.name: POWER_STATE
fsm_states.description: (SPMI) Reset / Sleep / Shutdown / Wakeup applied to a slave or group.

fsm_hints.trigger: An SSC begins a transaction; a Bus Park Cycle ends it. (SPMI) arbitration precedes the SSC of the winning master.
fsm_hints.rule: Every frame is MSB-first with an odd parity bit; a parity mismatch makes the receiver ignore the frame.
fsm_hints.abort: Loss of arbitration (SPMI) makes a master back off and retry; a missing/invalid SSC or Bus Park leaves devices idle.

anti_deadlock_rule: (SPMI) Bounded arbitration on priority/MASTER_ID guarantees exactly one master wins each round, and Transfer Bus Ownership hands the bus over cleanly, so no master can hold the bus indefinitely. The Bus Park Cycle always returns the bus to a known idle state. (RFFE) the single master fully controls timing.
exit_from_reset: After power-on/reset a device enters IDLE listening for an SSC. SPMI slaves adopt their SLAVE_ID and RFFE slaves their USID (assigned/strapped); the controller may issue Reset/Wakeup (SPMI) or initialize registers (RFFE) before normal operation.

default_ready_state_recommendation.bus_idle: SCLK low, SDATA low; listen for SSC.
default_ready_state_recommendation.spmi_master: Arbitrate only when it has a transaction; release ownership when done.
default_ready_state_recommendation.rffe_master: Drive SCLK and frames directly (single master).

channel_dependency_rules_master.note: Master generates START / STOP / repeated START; drives SCL; drives SDA during address byte and during write data bytes; releases SDA during read data bytes for slave to drive.

channel_dependency_rules_slave.note: Slave samples SDA on rising edge of SCL; drives SDA during read data bytes; may pull SCL LOW to clock-stretch; may NACK to indicate inability to continue.

arbitration_rule: (SPMI) Up to 4 masters arbitrate per transaction: higher command priority and/or lower MASTER_ID wins; exactly one master owns the bus at a time; ownership is transferred with Transfer Bus Ownership. A slave's Request during the arbitration window flags its need for service. RFFE has a single master and therefore no arbitration.
synchronization_rule: Clock synchronization via wired-AND on SCL: combined SCL LOW period = longest LOW among contending masters; combined SCL HIGH period = shortest HIGH among contending masters.

configurations.name: SPMI multi-master
configurations.description: Up to 4 masters arbitrate for up to 16 slaves; slave Request supported.

configurations.name: RFFE single-master
configurations.description: One master controls up to 15 slaves; no arbitration.

configurations.name: RFFE triggered
configurations.description: Trigger registers + Trigger event for simultaneous multi-slave state change.

configurations.name: SPMI grouped power state
configurations.description: Reset/Sleep/Shutdown/Wakeup applied to a group via Group Sub-ID.
